# Erdos.p624 — Erdős problem 624

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/624
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/624.lean`, theorem `erdos_624`, AMS 5).

Let $X$ be a finite set of size $n$ and $H(n)$ be such that there is a function
$f:\{A : A\subseteq X\}\to X$ so that for every $Y\subseteq X$ with $\lvert Y\rvert \geq H(n)$
we have $\left\{ f(A) : A\subseteq Y\right\}=X$.
Prove that $H(n)-\log_2 n \to \infty$.

## Statement
atTop.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => H n - Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) atTop

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
